description.en: Filters tool outputs, prunes stale context and discloses skills on demand for DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1.
description.zh: 为 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 过滤工具输出、裁剪陈旧上下文并按需披露技能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 提示词市场插件：对话框内一键浏览、搜索、收藏提示词，选中即写入输入框。零后端、免构建、数据只存本机。 | A prompt marketplace for DSH: browse, search and insert prompts straight into the composer.
description.zh: 对话框旁的提示词市场：浏览并搜索三个内置在线提示词源，可收藏或自建，选中即插入输入框。

description.en: Permanently delete DSH conversations with optional recursive deletion of forked and subagent sessions.
description.zh: 从 DSH 中永久删除会话，并可选择递归删除派生对话和子智能体会话。

description.en: Local meeting transcription with microphone and system audio recording, speaker labels, and transcript export for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS.
description.zh: 为 Apple Silicon macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地会议转写、麦克风与系统音频录制、说话人标签及文本导出。

description.en: Recoverable file and Git operations for coding agents, with shared recovery and redaction tools, a DSH shell adapter and audit records; optional native text-read protection is off by default.
description.zh: 为编码 Agent 提供可恢复的文件和 Git 操作、共享恢复与脱敏工具及 DSH Shell 适配器；保留审计记录，可选原生文本读取保护默认关闭。

description.en: Windows desktop vision and control for any application that has a window — a native editor, Excel, a proprietary installer, a game launcher — rather than a browser: screen_view returns the live screen as a real image block the model can see (never OCR or a text summary), desktop_control drives the pointer, keyboard and windows inside that same per-monitor-DPI-aware pixel space, and desktop_sequence runs a whole batch of actions in one call — bounded by maxSequenceSteps (24 by default) — so a task costs one round trip and one frame instead of one of each per action.
description.zh: Windows 桌面视觉与控制，面向任何有窗口的程序（原生编辑器、Excel、专有安装程序、游戏启动器），而不是浏览器：screen_view 把实时桌面作为真正的图像块交给模型（不是 OCR、不是文字描述），desktop_control 在同一个 per-monitor DPI 感知的像素空间里驱动指针、键盘与窗口，desktop_sequence 一次调用跑完一整串动作（受 maxSequenceSteps 限制，默认 24），让一个任务只花一次往返和一张图，而不是每个动作各花一次。

description.en: Per-conversation x-opencode-session injection for OpenCode Go in DeepSeek Harness - fixes 400 MissingSessionID without breaking other providers
description.zh: 给 OpenCode Go 按会话注入 x-opencode-session 请求头，修好 400 MissingSessionID 报错，还不影响其他模型服务商。

description.en: Read official DSH docs in the Plugins page; Creator mode searches docs and checks plugin npm metadata with native tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页阅读官方文档；创造模式用原生工具检索文档、查询插件 npm 元数据。

description.en: Multi-CLI worker sidebar for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with task dispatch, live conversation views, stop and follow-up controls, and custom role presets.
description.zh: 适用于 macOS / Windows 和 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的多 CLI 智能体侧栏插件，提供任务派遣、实时对话查看、停止与续聊及自定义角色预设。

description.en: Unofficial upstream bundle for DeepSeek Harness. CodeBuddy gateway with a runtime-synced model catalogue, per-model reasoning efforts, web search/fetch, image generation and a streaming credential bridge, plus TraeWork CN and Qoder CN subscription channels via local translation gateways and a key-type OpenAI-compatible provider registry, all managed from an accordion settings card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的非官方上游插件包：CodeBuddy 网关（模型目录动态同步、逐模型思考强度、联网搜索/抓取、生图、流式凭据桥），TraeWork CN 与 Qoder CN 两条订阅额度通道（本地 OpenAI 翻译网关），以及 key 型 OpenAI 兼容上游注册表，全部收在四区块手风琴设置卡里。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app experts into DSH: a settings-page market scans the local WorkBuddy expert directory (experts land there after you summon them in WorkBuddy) read-only for browsing, search and category filtering, with one-click install (exported to ~/.dsh/experts/ as role prompt + skills + avatar), update and uninstall; a picker capsule next to the input box switches the current session's expert — swapping role prompt, skills and an optional tool whitelist wholesale while keeping full session history, applied at the next model-request boundary.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面端召唤落盘的本地专家带进 DSH：设置页市场只读扫描本地专家目录，卡片浏览/搜索/分类，一键安装（导出到 ~/.dsh/experts/，含角色描述、skills 与头像）、更新与卸载；输入框旁的专家胶囊为当前会话切换专家——整组替换角色描述与 skills（可选工具白名单），保留全部会话历史，在下一个模型请求边界生效。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop-style theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with compact sidebar and chat layouts, light and dark themes, model and reasoning-effort controls, and an interactive pixel whale with spout, hop and tail-wag reactions on new sessions.
description.zh: 面向 macOS 与 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 的 Claude Code Desktop 风格主题，提供紧凑侧栏与会话布局、浅色与深色主题、模型与推理强度控件，以及支持随机喷水、轻弹和摆尾互动的新会话页像素小鲸鱼。

description.en: DSH 桌面端 Claude 风格主题插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端换上 Claude Code 风格皮肤，支持明暗主题和模型、强度选择。

description.en: Rotates the DSH app background wallpaper from a folder on a timer with cross-fade transitions; falls back to four bundled SVG gradients when no folder is set, and adds background-opacity, wallpaper-dimming, blur and text-shadow controls so panels and text stay readable.
description.zh: 按设定间隔从指定文件夹轮换 DSH 应用背景壁纸（带交叉淡化）；未配置文件夹时使用随插件分发的 4 张 SVG 渐变壁纸，并提供背景不透明度、壁纸压暗、毛玻璃模糊与文字阴影四个可读性调节，让面板与文字在花哨的图上仍然看得清。

description.en: Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness: the model answers with an openui-lang program and the Web GUI renders it as a live, interactive UI inside the chat
description.zh: 让模型直接生成可点击操作的交互界面，聊天里就能用，不用再读一大段文字。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a photo of a surface becomes a complete tileable PBR material set, fully local via ComfyUI (FLUX.2 Klein 4B instruction edit + deterministic PBR derivation). GUI workbench, five agent tools, and a setup tool that finds your ComfyUI and downloads its own weights.
description.zh: 一张照片就能在本地生成整套可平铺 PBR 贴图，直接拿去做游戏和 3D 材质。

description.en: Arbitrary file upload, reading, OCR, and rendering for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接上传、阅读、OCR 识别并渲染任意格式文件，让文档处理更顺手。

description.en: Todoist-style todo management in the sidebar with projects, labels and priorities, CJK-aware natural-language quick-add, repeat rules, a stats dashboard, import and export, seven agent tools and due-time reminders.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的类 Todoist 待办管理：项目/标签/优先级、中英双语自然语言快速添加、重复规则、统计仪表盘、导入导出、七个 Agent 工具与到期提醒。

description.en: DSH 对话体验增强套件（零 DSH 源码改动，纯插件注入）。回合呈现：思考/工具调用聚合 chip · 步骤卡/总结卡 · 共享活动抽屉。正文增强：proto-tabs 卡片 · diagram 流程图 · 生图画廊。界面与工具：会话头部标签上移 · 桌面壳窗口控制留位与主题同步 · 对话截图（无头浏览器渲染 markdown/shiki/mermaid）· download 下载工具（实时进度/速度/ETA）。另有可选的 KR 对话双栏执行大盘。
description.zh: 不改官方源码就给对话加交互卡片、执行大盘和记忆钉，读起来更顺、过程看得懂。

description.en: Verifies letters signed by other agents: a canonical field order, digest and HMAC checks, and fail-closed handling of missing or unregistered fields. Off by default; when enabled, a letter that fails any check is refused rather than delivered.
description.zh: 校验其他 agent 写来的信：规范字段顺序、摘要与 HMAC 校验。默认关闭；开启后，缺字段或未登记字段不放行，任何一项不过就拒收。

description.en: Glass weather pill in the session header with 23 weather states, each with its own tint, SVG icon and canvas particle layer, per-field visibility switches, and a get_weather tool backed by keyless Open-Meteo data.
description.zh: 会话顶栏的玻璃天气胶囊：23 种天气状态各自配色、SVG 图标与 canvas 粒子层，可按字段开关显示内容，并注册 get_weather 工具（Open-Meteo 免密钥数据）。

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the catalog synced automatically, each model routed to the endpoint the official docs assign, and free *-free models hidden by default because they only run inside the OpenCode client.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console (Zen) 模型：在「设置 → 插件」填入 Console API Key 后即可选用 Console 的对话模型，模型目录自动同步，每个模型按官方文档路由到对应端点，免费 *-free 模型默认不列出（它们只能在 OpenCode 客户端内运行）。

description.en: Audible feedback for the DSH web interface: button presses are classified by semantics (normal, primary, toggle, send, close, danger, link) and the current session's task transitions (started, finished, failed) plus any pending interaction play a cue, each scenario with its own cue picker and switch on a settings page. All 78 cues and 12 sound packs are synthesised in the browser with the Web Audio API, so the package ships no audio files and makes no network request. A community port of dsh-plugin-uisfx to DSH 0.2.0, with the ported changes recorded in PROVENANCE.md.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面补上可听的语义反馈：按钮按下按语义分类发声（普通、主要、开关、发送、关闭、危险、链接），当前会话的任务开始、成功结束、失败结束以及出现待处理交互也各有一声，每个情景都能在设置页单独挑音效、单独开关。78 个 cue 与 12 个音色包全部由浏览器用 Web Audio API 实时合成，因此包里不含音频文件、也不发起网络请求。这是 dsh-plugin-uisfx 向 DSH 0.2.0 的社区移植版，改动逐条记录在 PROVENANCE.md。

description.en: Sidebar panel for the announcement file and the ticket status table. It lists the announcements together with how many sessions have seen each one, shows the delivery status, and lets the user post, edit and delete entries. Requires the third-party dsh-better-sidebar plugin.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：把公告和投递状态表放进 DSH 界面 —— 列出公告以及每条有几个会话见过，并让用户发布、编辑、删除条目。需要第三方插件 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: An OpenCode Go model source for DSH: it reads the opencode-go catalog from Models.dev and serves it on a separate opencode-go-live route, leaving the built-in opencode-go route in place. The catalog snapshot is cached under the DSH home and a failed refresh keeps the last successful one; its own Models settings card edits the route key and can render OpenCode Go subscription usage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 OpenCode Go 模型来源：从 Models.dev 读取 opencode-go 目录，在独立的 opencode-go-live 路由上提供，内置 opencode-go 路由保持原样。目录快照缓存在 DSH home 下，刷新失败时沿用上一次成功的目录；插件自带 Models 设置卡片用于填写该路由密钥，并可显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量。

description.en: A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the proxy's fake-ip block (198.18.0.0/15 by default), so web_fetch works under mihomo/Clash TUN mode without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables. IP literals and private, loopback and reserved destinations stay blocked.
description.zh: ctx.web 的 fake-ip 感知抓取后端，接管官方 http provider id：当某主机名的每一条 DNS 应答都是代理 fake-ip 段（默认 198.18.0.0/15）内的占位地址时予以接受，从而在 mihomo/Clash TUN 模式下无需关闭 fake-ip、也无需设置代理环境变量即可使用 web_fetch；IP 字面量与私有、回环、保留地址仍被拒绝。
给 DSH 加上长期记忆，每轮自动把该记的注入对话，全程本地检索不调模型。

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste your Console API key and the Console's chat models become selectable in DSH.
description.zh: 填上 OpenCode Console 的 API Key，就能在 DSH 里直接选用 Console 的聊天模型。

description.en: External vision proxy extension for DeepSeek Harness, enabling text-only models  to analyze and understand images via OpenAI-compatible vision APIs.

Desk-to-desk tickets between sessions on one machine. A session says which desk it belongs to by putting a number prefix in its title; a ticket names one desk and is taken by the first session of that desk to start working, so the desk is the address and a ticket is not delivered to a session that is just passing by.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上会话之间的「单子」：会话用标题里的编号前缀表明自己属于哪张桌；单子投给某张桌，由那张桌最先开始干活的那个会话取走 —— 桌是地址，路过的会话不会收到它。

description.en: An announcement file shared by several agent sessions on one machine. It is a plain text file the agents only append to; before each step a session receives the entries it has not seen yet, a new session catches up on the ones still in effect, and a session whose context was compacted gets them re-sent.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上多个会话共用的公告文件：一个只许追加的纯文本文件。每个会话在下一步之前收到自己还没见过的条目；新会话补看仍在有效期内的；上下文被压缩过的会话会收到一次重发。

description.en: Makes a connection between two DSH sessions a first-class object: drag from the composer anchor or a session row to open one, set a permission in each direction, and mount cards on it. Each end gets five host tools for messaging at a chosen urgency, reading the peer work state, and sharing a convention box; awareness is pull-based, so an idle connection costs no context.
description.zh: 把两个 DSH 会话之间的「连接」做成一等对象：从输入框锚点或会话行拖拽建连，两个方向各自设权限，并可在连接上装载卡片。两端各获得五个宿主工具，用于按指定紧急度传话、读取对端工作状态、共用公约盒；感知为拉取式，空闲连接不占上下文。

description.en: Token usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: a bar above the composer opens billing token totals, trend charts, per-model and per-project breakdowns and a custom date range, read from local session logs of DSH, Codex, Claude Code, Trae and WorkBuddy. With a self-hosted portal URL and an app key it also reports usage events to that portal; with neither configured it collects nothing. It exposes token_usage tools plus a ctx.tokenReport service, and never collects conversation content.
description.zh: DSH 的 token 用量面板：输入框上方一条用量条，点开是计费总量、趋势图、按模型/项目/来源的分组明细与自定义日期范围，数据来自本机 DSH / Codex / Claude Code / Trae / WorkBuddy 的会话日志；填了自建服务端地址与 appKey 后，用量事件会实时上报到那个服务端，两者都没配时一个字节都不采集；另提供 token_usage 工具与 ctx.tokenReport 服务。不采集对话内容。

description.en: Prompt library stored in the plugin config, with a Settings page and a composer picker: the ticked prompts are injected into every model step of that session, and a subagent inherits the selection of its nearest ancestor session.
description.zh: 提示词库存放在插件配置中，含 Settings 页面与输入框选择器：勾中的提示词注入该会话的每一步模型调用，subagent 继承其最近祖先会话的选择。

description.en: Run one deterministic skill-routing pass on every user instruction, so the skill catalog is consulted before the model answers instead of after it remembers. On the host it scores the live catalog from the instruction's keywords and the catalog metadata, with no LLM or embedding call, and appends a single producer-tagged message to the step: a ranked shortlist by default, the winning SKILL.md body once the score clears a threshold, or an instruction to call a named router skill exactly once. Unrelated instructions stay silent.
description.zh: 对每条用户指令自动做一次确定性的技能路由，让技能目录在模型作答之前就被查阅，而不是等它自己想起来。宿主侧只依据指令关键词与目录元数据打分，不调用 LLM 也不做向量检索，然后向该步追加恰好一条带生产者标签的消息：默认是候选排名简报，分数过线时改注入冠军技能的 SKILL.md 正文，也可以只注入一句「立刻调用某个路由技能」。无关指令保持沉默。

description.en: Adds Delete conversation and Batch delete to the sidebar session menu; a deleted conversation and its subagent sessions are moved to the Windows recycle bin, from where they can be restored.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话行菜单中增加「删除对话」与「批量删除」；删除的对话及其子代理会话移入 Windows 回收站，可从回收站还原。

description.en: DSHSH — a harness that harnesses your harness
description.zh: 给 harness 再套一层 harness 的递归插件，专治各种 harness 不够用的场景。

description.en: 将>20行的粘贴文本打包为一个卡片。可预览，可解包到输入框
description.zh: 粘贴超过20行的文本自动打包成卡片，可预览、可解包回输入框，让长文本不刷屏。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: delete sessions from the running Web runtime — live store, workspace records, and on-disk artifacts. Host half + web client half in one package.
description.zh: 在运行中的 Web 端直接删除会话，实时数据、工作区记录和磁盘文件一并清干净。

description.en: 给 DSH 加提示音：对话完成 / 需要授权 / 弹出提问时响铃。零依赖，Web Audio 现场合成，内置设置界面（音量滑杆 + 四段试听）。
description.zh: 对话完成、需要授权或弹出提问时自动响铃，把你从别的窗口叫回来，音量可调还能试听。

description.en: 把另一台电脑变成你 DSH 的远程 Agent 同事：任务在副机本地持久跑，主机只收 handoff 摘要与产物清单 | Turn another computer into a remote agent worker for your DSH: tasks run & persist on the worker, the hub only receives a handoff summary + artifact manifest
description.zh: 把另一台电脑变成你 DSH 的远程 Agent 同事，任务在副机本地持久跑，主机只收摘要和产物清单。

description.en: Whalesong Studio (鲸歌工坊): write a long novel with a crew of AI agents, then publish it as an illustrated website. A plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让一群 AI 智能体帮你写长篇小说，写完还能一键生成带插图的网站发布。

description.en: DSH Feishu self-built app integration: WebSocket inbound messages, OK-reaction acknowledgement, and turn replies on the original chat.
description.zh: 让飞书消息直达 DSH 智能体，自动确认并原聊回复，轻松开启对话。

description.en: Takes over the compaction threshold on every mounted engine: forces headroomTokens to -1e6 so the ratio is the only term in the trigger, keeps retention below it on every write path, reroutes the compaction call to a chosen model, and adds a panel with a one-click compaction button and a per-session compaction log.
description.zh: 接管所有已挂载压缩引擎的触发阈值：把 headroomTokens 强制成 −1e6，使比值成为触发点的唯一决定项；在每条下发路径上保证保留量低于触发点；把压缩调用改派到指定模型；并提供一键立即压缩与本会话压缩记录面板。

description.en: Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and the plugin ships its own embedded web dashboard (it starts the HTTP server itself, no separate process) for browsing, graphing and controlled deletion.
description.zh: 跨会话、跨工程的长期记忆：turn/end 时非阻塞派发无感静默沉淀，写入本机 SQLite（FTS5 trigram 全文索引，含增删改同步触发器）供后续回合召回；记忆按项目作用域与全局树分层存储，并自带内嵌 Web 看板（插件自身起 HTTP 服务，非独立进程）用于浏览、图谱与受控删除。

description.en: Session cost in rubles in the composer dock — the tariff in effect with its countdown, the API cost at that tariff, the CBR rate, the total including subagents, cache savings, and DeepSeek Platform balances.
description.zh: 在输入框坞区显示以卢布计的当前会话费用：当前时段与倒计时、该时段的 API 费用、央行汇率、含 subagent 的合计、缓存节省与 DeepSeek 平台余额。

description.en: Answers what the voice model delegates by admitting a turn to a DeepSeek Harness session and speaking the agent's reply.

Bridges DeepSeek Harness sessions to Feishu/Lark, Telegram and DingTalk: each chat is bound to a resumable DSH session, replies stream back as cards, and a task-end card reports the model, token usage, step count and duration. Question and permission-approval cards are answerable from the chat, and a web settings pane configures the per-channel credentials.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话接入飞书/Lark、Telegram 与钉钉：每个聊天绑定一个可续接的 DSH 会话，回复以卡片流式回传，任务结束时用一张结果卡汇报模型、token 用量、步数与耗时。提问与权限审批可直接在聊天里作答，各渠道凭据在 Web 设置面板中配置。

description.en: Bring a DSH plugin repository's build and release pipeline into the app: a sidebar panel listing each repository's latest workflow run, its releases, and how far the local checkout has drifted from the last release, with buttons to trigger a build, cut a release, publish a draft, re-run, cancel, or read the failed-step log. Drives the workflows through the machine's authenticated gh CLI, so the plugin stores no credential of its own, and which repositories are tracked lives in a config file rather than the package.
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件仓库的持续构建与发布搬进应用：侧边栏面板逐仓库显示最近一次工作流运行、已发布与草稿 Release，以及本地检出相对上次发布的领先与未提交情况，并提供触发构建、发布、公开草稿、重跑、取消、查失败日志等按钮。通过本机已登录的 gh CLI 驱动工作流，插件自身不保存任何凭据，被监视的仓库列表放在配置文件里、不打进包。

description.en: Extra LLM provider routes for DeepSeek Harness: OpenCode Go with per-session x-opencode-session routing, and OpenAI Codex over ChatGPT-subscription OAuth.

Pushes DSH session events to phone IM and lets you reply straight under that message, injecting the text back into the right session. Covers nine event kinds: task completion, execution error, execution blocked, manual abort, token limit reached, abnormal interruption, waiting for your answer, permission request, and waiting for plan confirmation. Channels are QQ single-chat bots and Feishu custom apps, both over WebSocket long connections — no public IP, domain or tunneling needed. Several bots can be configured at once, each subscribing to the sessions it cares about. Approvals and questions arrive with tappable buttons, and replies route home through three layers (button, quoted reply, explicit short-id prefix), falling back to the most recent intervention-needed notification and echoing which session it went to.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话事件推到手机 IM，并允许在那条消息下直接回复回注到正确会话。覆盖九类事件：任务完成、执行错误、执行被阻塞、手动中止、Token 达到上限、异常中断、等待我回答、权限请求、等待计划确认；通道支持 QQ 单聊机器人与飞书自建应用，两者均走 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 IP、域名或内网穿透。可同时配置多台机器人，各自订阅自己关心的会话。审批与提问以可点按钮下发，回复按「按钮 → 引用回复 → 显式短 id 前缀」三层路由归位，兜底发给最近一条需人介入的通知并回显投递目标。

description.en: Browse, search and install skills from the public SkillHub catalogue, then enable, disable, update or remove them without leaving Harness. Category chips carry the upstream total for each category; the details drawer has tabs for the file tree, version history, permissions, third-party security-scan results and upstream metrics. An installed skill is written into the harness skill root as an ordinary local skill, and disabling one moves its directory out of that root rather than flagging it.
description.zh: 浏览、搜索并安装公开的 SkillHub 技能库,启用、停用、更新或卸载都不必离开 Harness。分类按钮带该分类的上游总数;详情抽屉提供文件树、版本历史、权限、第三方安全扫描结论与上游指标等页签。装好的技能会作为一个普通本地技能写入 harness 的技能根目录,而「停用」是把它的目录移出该根目录,不是打标记。

description.en: Graph-based code context, impact analysis, review workflows, interactive graphs, and permission-controlled refactoring for DSH using the code-review-graph engine.
description.zh: 基于 code-review-graph 引擎，为 DSH 提供代码图谱上下文、影响分析、审查工作流、交互式图谱和权限控制的重构。

description.en: A Herta theme for DeepSeek Harness: an ASCII boot opening ported from the upstream Herta project, a violet palette of design tokens, swappable wallpapers (four bundled, plus image URL, local import, solid colour or off) and a "Herta Appearance" page in DSH settings. Doubles as the theme that dsh-herta ships with.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的黑塔主题：移植自上游 Herta 项目的开机 ASCII 开场、一整套紫罗兰设计令牌、可替换的壁纸（自带四张，也支持图片网址 / 本机导入 / 纯色 / 关掉），以及 DSH 设置里的「黑塔外观」页。它同时就是 dsh-herta 自带的那套主题。

description.en: Everything (voidtools) file-name search: everything_find queries the local Everything index to locate files and folders on any indexed drive in milliseconds, and adds a configuration card to the Plugins page.
description.zh: 基于 Everything 索引的全盘文件名搜索：everything_find 工具毫秒级定位任意盘上的文件与文件夹，并在插件页提供配置卡片。

description.en: Copy session IDs, send messages to live or saved sessions, and view session token usage.
description.zh: 复制会话 ID、向在线或已保存的会话发送消息，并查看会话 token 用量。

description.en: Self-organizing multi-agent clusters with no orchestrator. Real DSH subagents coordinate through a shared append-only log that each agent reads and writes on its own schedule, with no topology and one dispatch per agent; a snapshot mode is also included where the harness freezes each neighbour view into the prompt and drives a ring/mesh/swarm cluster to convergence.
description.zh: 无编排者的自组织多智能体集群。真实 DSH 子智能体通过共享的只追加日志协调，由各智能体自行决定读写时机，无拓扑、每个智能体只派发一次；另附快照模式，由调度层把邻居视图冻结进提示词并驱动环形/网状/群集收敛。

description.en: Checks each step of a plan before you approve it, using command rules plus Jev or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with logprobs, and marks steps that can't be undone, affect things outside the workspace, weren't asked for or are too vague on the plan review card.
description.zh: 在你同意执行计划前逐步检查每一步，用命令规则加上 Jev 或支持 logprobs 的 OpenAI 兼容端点，在计划审阅卡片上标出无法恢复、影响工作区以外、需求没提到或描述太模糊的步骤。

description.en: One-button prompt optimizer: rewrites the composer draft via a configurable strategy, with an editable template, few-shot examples, pinned models and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 一键提示词优化：按可配置策略改写输入框草稿，提供可编辑模板、Few-shot 示例、指定模型与推理强度。

description.en: Turns file and directory paths in DSH chat into clickable buttons: click one to preview the file in the right sidebar, or open it with the system default application.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话中的文件与目录路径变成可点击按钮：点击即在右侧侧边栏预览，或用系统默认程序打开。

description.en: Branch and worktree management for DeepSeek Harness: the workspace toolbar shows the current branch with in-place switching, plus an IDEA-style branch selector, remote branch checkout, context menus (create, rename, delete, copy), push and update, and branch isolation into standalone worktrees with managed creation and deletion.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 git 分支与 worktree 管理：工作区工具栏显示当前分支并可原地切换；支持 IDEA 风格分支选择器、远程分支检出、右键操作菜单（新建/重命名/删除/复制）、推送与更新当前分支，以及把分支隔离到独立 worktree 工作区并管理其创建与删除。

description.en: Adds a refresh button to the conversation header in DeepSeek Harness, reloading the current page in one click without losing the conversation. Desktop-first, client-only, zero tokens.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部加一个刷新按钮，一键原地重载页面且不丢会话数据。桌面端优先、纯客户端、零 token。

description.en: DSH plugin: read and write DingTalk AI Tables through the official dws CLI, adding ten dingtalk_aitable_* tools, a settings panel, and scheduled CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 插件：包装钉钉官方 dws CLI，读写钉钉 AI 表格，提供 10 个 dingtalk_aitable_* 工具、设置面板与定时 CSV 导出。

description.en: Picks a random installed skin on every DeepSeek Harness launch and enables exactly that skin, with an on/off switch and a shuffle action inside the Skins settings page. Skins the running host would refuse to load are excluded, and a manual switch still applies until the next launch.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时随机启用一个已安装皮肤，并在「设置 → 皮肤」页内提供开关与「立即随机换一个」按钮。宿主会拒绝加载的皮肤自动排除；手动切换的皮肤一直有效到下次启动。

description.en: Low-token web search that returns only {title, url, snippet} per hit — vendor extras such as answer, score and raw_content never enter the context. Five interchangeable backends (Tavily, Brave, SearXNG, Google CSE, Exa) with automatic failover to the next usable one in fallback / chain order when the primary fails, deduplicating repeated providers. Returned URLs and snippets are sanitized of tracking parameters.
description.zh: 低 Token 联网搜索：只把结果裁成 {title, url, snippet} 三个字段返回，厂商附带的 answer / score / raw_content 等一律不进上下文。后端可在 Tavily、Brave、SearXNG、Google CSE、Exa 五种之间配置，主后端失败时按 fallback / chain 顺序自动切换到下一个可用后端（同一后端去重）。返回的 URL 与摘要经清洗，除去跟踪参数。

description.en: Let Codex dispatch tasks to DeepSeek Harness workspaces, follow execution, read results, and continue collaboration through a local bridge and companion Codex skill.
description.zh: 通过本机桥接插件与配套 Codex 技能，让 Codex 向 DeepSeek Harness 工作区派发任务、跟踪执行、回读结果并继续协作。

description.en: Round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows desktop, reusing existing Agent sessions with discussion, editable task cards, sequential and parallel steps, shared meeting files, and secretary minutes.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 桌面版 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的圆桌会议，复用已有 Agent 会话，提供讨论、可编辑任务卡、顺序与并行步骤、会议文件归档及秘书纪要。

description.en: DSH 酒馆插件，支持角色扮演单聊、群聊，把聊天写成小说；支持配置 ComfyUI 画图，台词语音合成。/ Aha Tavern: DSH Tavern Plugin, supporting roleplay single chat and group chat, turning chats into novels; supports ComfyUI configuration for drawing and dialog speech synthesis.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里开一间酒馆，和角色单聊群聊、把对话写成小说，还能配 ComfyUI 画图和语音合成。

description.en: Read-only attachment library for DeepSeek Harness: every stored image and file, its size, and which conversations still use it.
description.zh: 在设置里查看本机存的所有图片和文件附件，还能看到大小和哪些会话还在用。

description.en: Dual avatars (user + assistant) for the DeepSeek Harness chat transcript, with an Avatars settings page.
description.zh: 给聊天记录加上用户和助手双头像，一眼分清谁在说话，还能在设置页里换头像。

description.en: 一个类似 Geek 风格的 DeepSeek Harness 批量卸载插件工具，支持终端交互勾选与进度条。
description.zh: 像 Geek Uninstaller 一样在终端里勾选批量卸载 DSH 插件，带进度条，清理更省事。

description.en: DSH 开屏视频管理插件：在设置里管理开屏动画的播放列表（顺序/随机/单次），支持 mp4/webm/m4v/mov。
description.zh: 在设置里给 DSH 开屏动画排片，顺序、随机、单次随你选，支持多种视频格式。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: native ctk_* sandbox tools, a local FTS5 knowledge base, and a routing gate that keeps bulk output out of the conversation. No third-party runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把命令输出留在沙箱里，只把结论带回对话，省 token 还能查本地知识库。

description.en: 极简匹配DSH官方风格的计费卡片. 会话与轮次费用估算插件，支持多价格源、模型独立币种和 DeepSeek 峰谷计费。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里实时显示当前会话和每轮对话的花费估算，帮你随时掌握用量成本。

description.en: Video workspace background with a translucent composer for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 工作区加上动态视频背景和半透明输入框，开屏结束后才启用，不打扰原生界面。

description.en: 列出并删除 DSH 已归档会话：默认移入回收站可恢复，带二次确认与日志归属校验。
description.zh: 把 DSH 里已归档的会话列出来并删掉，默认进回收站可恢复，删前还得二次确认。

description.en: Discussion mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - a sidebar-toggled design conversation where the agent consults as a domain expert, acting tools are denied, and only the user can end the mode. 讨论模式
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个讨论模式，让 AI 先当行业专家陪你聊清想法，动手工具全禁用，退出只能你来定。

description.en: 把任务派发给本机 ZCode CLI 无头进程的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：面板可监视/终止/续跑/换通道；单写者文件锁 + 用量台账 + 降级链。支持付费套餐与免费额度（Start Plan 活动赠送）两种额度，后者托管官方 agent 走 app-server。
description.zh: 把任务丢给本机 ZCode 无头进程跑，悬浮面板随时看进度、续跑或终止，还能省着用额度。

description.en: DSH 原生抖音助手：有限自主观看、共享人格与兴趣记忆、原生设置和观看日报。

Binds a Feishu/Lark bot to DeepSeek Harness over a WebSocket long connection: incoming messages run through an agent session and stream back to the chat, chat commands such as /attach manage the live session, and feishu_* tools let the model push messages.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket 长连接把飞书机器人绑到 DeepSeek Harness：收到的消息跑在 agent 会话里并流式回传，/attach 等聊天命令管理活动会话，模型可调用 feishu_* 工具推送消息。

description.en: DSHarness Go 互联插件，仅适配 DSHarness Go Android App。连接电脑工作区、会话、消息和任务。开源开发预览版。
description.zh: 把电脑上的 DSH 工作区、会话、消息和任务连到手机，随时远程查看和操作。

description.en: 国内免费模型一键添加：把 Agnes AI 免费大模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。安装后自动出现在「设置→模型」，自带密钥输入框，免费模型自动进聊天框模型列表，官方新免费模型自动更新。
description.zh: 装上就能用，把 Agnes AI 免费大模型一键接进 DeepSeek Harness，自动出现在设置和聊天模型列表里。

description.en: Native Telegram bridge for Paean Harness (DeepSeek Harness distribution): chat with your agent and drive sessions, models, workspaces and goals from your phone. Also works with other DSH profiles.
description.zh: 在手机上用 Telegram 直接和 DSH 智能体聊天，随时切换会话、模型、工作区和目标。

description.en: A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0), adding per-conversation companions with whale-girl, MIKU and business blue whale skins, model-themed colors, token-rate animation, completion reminders and shared feeding and affinity.
description.zh: 基于 zhu1090093659/dsh-pet（Apache-2.0）改造，新增每个活跃会话一只桌宠，提供鲸鱼娘、MIKU 与商务小蓝鲸皮肤、模型配色、随生成速度跑动、完成待查看提醒、共享喂食与亲密度。

description.en: Use DeepSeek's web chat inside DSH - your real chat history in the leftmost sidebar, a Chat/Work switch beside the agent mode, plus streaming answers, thinking, web search and file uploads you can keep asking about.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接用 DeepSeek 网页版聊天，左侧栏同步真实历史记录，支持流式回答、思考、联网搜索和文件上传。

description.en: DSH 插件索引：只认 package.json 里的 dsh.bundle.patch 判定真伪，收录 1 万余个经校验的插件，可在 DSH 内一键安装。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里逛一万多个经过真实性校验的第三方插件，看中哪个一键就能装。

description.en: Delete DSH conversations for real: a 删除对话 item in the sidebar session menu plus out-of-band deletion of the session log and projection cache.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单里加个「删除对话」，能把会话记录和缓存真正删干净。
在会话记录里划词，把选中的内容引用到当前对话，或直接分派给子智能体处理。

description.en: Local Qwen Image workspace for DeepSeek Harness: MLX/MFLUX, LoRA, ControlNet, inpainting, native file picking, persistent jobs and private gallery. 本地生图 · 隐私图库
description.zh: 在 DSH 里本地跑 Qwen Image 生图改图，支持 LoRA、ControlNet 和局部重绘，作品只存自己电脑。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that registers the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server as mcp__rea__* tools — third-party adapter
description.zh: 把 REA 逆向工程 MCP 服务器接进 DSH，让你直接调用工具拆解分析任意目标。

description.en: DSH plugin: finish a DeepSeek account sign-in from a remote browser (loopback redirect claim + in-page paste panel)
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 账号登录在你眼前的浏览器里直接完成，不用再折腾远程回调。

description.en: Let your dsh freely invoke any agent or model to review.
description.zh: 让 dsh 自由调用任意 Agent 或模型来帮你审查内容，轻松搞定多模型交叉检查。

description.en: Split reading from deciding: the root agent plans and owns every file mutation; subagents are structurally read-only and report findings as summaries.
description.zh: 让主 Agent 专心做计划和决策，子 Agent 只读不写，避免乱改文件。
给本机服务配个随机域名和随机口令，想开就开，随时对外访问。

description.en: 新会话自动接续：注入约 55 token 的接续指针，没有交接文档时直接复用 DSH 已有的压缩摘要，不调模型、不额外生成。
description.zh: 新会话开头自动接上一段，指认上个会话和交接文档，没文档就复用压缩摘要，省 token。

description.en: 会话删除插件
DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧栏工作区文件夹（分组）与会话移动 · Workspace folders and session move for DSH
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧栏加上工作区分组文件夹，还能把会话真正搬到别的工作区，整理起来更顺手。

description.en: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness: move conversations to a trash, restore them, or delete them permanently after a second confirmation.
description.zh: 给会话加个回收站：侧边栏一键移入，误删能还原，确认两次才彻底删除。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a provider + model icon in the sidebar for every session, updated live from the composer model selector with a last-request fallback for history sessions; aggregator routes render the provider logo with a 10px model logo in the corner.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏为每个会话显示 provider 与 model 图标，跟随输入框选择器即时更新，历史会话回退到最近一次请求；聚合路由（如 opencode-go、traex）显示 provider 主图并叠加 10px model 小图标。

description.en: TFR《烈焰升腾》长征 / Loji 路线主题皮肤 for DeepSeek Harness — 磷光终端 + 数据雨 + CRT 扫描线，四套部门预设各自带徽记、配色与背景纹样。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上长征主题皮肤，磷光终端配数据雨和 CRT 扫描线，四套部门预设一键切换。

description.en: DiagramKit — 结构化示意图的排版量尺与自检器：量真实字宽、查溢出/重叠/穿框，每次调用返回「图 + 可执行的修法」。DeepSeek Harness 插件。
description.zh: 画结构化示意图时帮你量准字宽、查出溢出重叠穿框，还顺手给出改法。

description.en: 公式与数学插图工具：LaTeX 公式离线转 PNG、参数化几何/曲面模板、数值自校验。DeepSeek Harness 插件（适配 0.1.0-rc.6 与 0.2.0-rc.2）。
description.zh: 把 LaTeX 公式和几何图形离线转成 PNG，还能自动校验数值，写文档做图省心。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏左下角显示账号余额、今日 token 消耗与花费
description.zh: 在侧边栏左下角实时显示账号余额、今日 token 消耗和花费，用量花钱一目了然。

description.en: Personal agent for DeepSeek Harness: persistent chat, goals, actionable ideas, multi-session task coordination, and self-evolution through plugin discovery and recommendations.
DSH工作区内跨会话记忆插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 工作区加上跨会话长期记忆，关掉会话也不丢上下文，需要时按需取回。

description.en: Turn-handoff reminder for DeepSeek Harness: a centred popup and a synthesized chime for every Agent handoff.
description.zh: Agent 每完成一轮就弹窗加提示音，提醒你该接手了，不用一直盯着屏幕。

description.en: DSH plugin: offline official Godot documentation as agent tools - ranked search, class/member/enum lookup, and API checks against the engine version the project really uses. / 把本地 Godot 官方文档变成 DSH 的离线文档工具链。
description.zh: 把本地 Godot 官方文档变成离线查询工具，按项目实际引擎版本搜类、查成员、验 API。

description.en: 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）里使用 OpenCode Zen 的匿名免费模型：原生 LlmAdapter，无需 API Key，零依赖。
description.zh: 不用 API Key 就能在 DSH 里白嫖 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型，装上即用，零依赖。

description.en: JEV agent preset bundle with prompt-guided task routing, cross-verification and quantitative checklists.
description.zh: 给 AI 智能体预设一套 JEV 工作流：自动分派任务、交叉验证结果，还用清单量化检查。

description.en: Cross-session message forwarding between DSH sessions: extract one model reply, a user message, or a multi-selected batch of messages and images from one session and deliver it into another, with silent send, draft fill, or send-and-jump delivery, plus prompt templates.
description.zh: DSH 会话间消息转发：把单条模型回复、用户消息或多选合并的消息与图片从上游会话提取出来投递到另一个会话，支持静默发送、填入草稿、发送并跳转三种投递方式，并可套用提示词模板。

description.en: DSH 右侧边栏的移动设备面板：把 mobilecli 封装成实时画面 + 直接操作，一套 API 同时覆盖 iOS 与 Android，并把 mobilecli 自带的 skill 一并注册给模型。A mobile device panel for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar — wraps mobilecli as a live screen with direct interaction, one API for iOS and Android, plus the bundled mobilecli skill registered for the model.
AI companion with a learned body clock, real offline sleep, its own memory, and self-reported affect delivered through the same judge math as the pi version.
description.zh: 有生物钟、会真实睡觉、有自己的记忆和情绪的 AI 伴侣，主动冲动以独立 turn 投递。

description.en: Floating FC/NES game hall for DSH Web with fceumm, local ROM upload, and GitHub online library.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右下角挂悬浮球打开 FC/NES 游戏厅（fceumm），支持本地上传与自填 GitHub 在线库。

description.en: Host-side macOS notifications for questions, approvals and finished replies — immune to hidden-renderer notification loss, with icon, sound and click-to-raise.
description.zh: 宿主侧 macOS 系统通知：提问/审批/回复完成即时送达，免疫渲染层隐藏丢通知，带图标、提示音与点击抬窗。

description.en: Resident search index living in the host process: hot_find (fuzzy filename and path match, with frecency and git status), hot_fuzzy (content search that tolerates typos, including in Chinese), hot_grep (literal and regex content search), hot_plan (groups hits per file so a batch of files can be read in order) and hot_stats. One in-memory line index is built once and rebuilt on demand, so a query does not spawn a process.
description.zh: 活在宿主进程里的常驻检索索引：hot_find（文件名与路径模糊匹配，带 frecency 与 git 状态）、hot_fuzzy（内容检索，中文错字也能命中）、hot_grep（字面与正则内容检索）、hot_plan（按文件聚合命中，便于排批量阅读顺序）与 hot_stats。一份内存行索引只建一次、按需重建，单次查询不启动进程。

description.en: Independent per-pane zoom for the DSH web shell: Ctrl+wheel over a pane, Ctrl+± / Ctrl+0 for the focused pane. Works with the official look and every skin.
description.zh: 支持 DSH Web 上的每个面板独立缩放：鼠标悬浮在面板上 Ctrl+滚轮，或对选中的面板 Ctrl+±，Ctrl+0恢复。兼容官方界面风格及皮肤。

description.en: Makes the built-in web_fetch tool work when Clash / mihomo runs in TUN mode with fake-ip: it lets the fake-ip address ranges (198.18.0.0/15, fdfe:dcba:9876::/64, 2001:2::/48) past the public-address check that otherwise rejects them, while loopback, private and link-local addresses stay blocked as before. Works with no proxy environment variables and no Clash changes.
description.zh: 让内置 web_fetch 在 Clash / mihomo 以 TUN + fake-ip 模式运行时正常工作：只放行 fake-ip 地址段（198.18.0.0/15、fdfe:dcba:9876::/64、2001:2::/48）通过公网地址校验，回环、内网与链路本地地址仍照旧拦截。无需设置代理环境变量，也无需改动 Clash。

description.en: Fills missing model parameters from models.dev, imports models from configured providers, and writes per-field overrides for built-in models, with prices in USD or native CNY set as manual rates or a reference price times a multiplier.

description.en: Make F5, Ctrl+F5, and Ctrl+Shift+R reload the DeepSeek Harness page.
description.zh: 让 F5、Ctrl+F5 和 Ctrl+Shift+R 都能刷新 DeepSeek Harness 页面。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness covering approval requests, questions, run completion, errors and sign-in prompts, with the conversation name as the first line of every notification.

description.en: Hot-swap the outbound proxy in dsh between direct, system, and saved proxies without restarting.
description.zh: 在 dsh 运行过程中热切换出站代理（直连/系统/自定义），无需重启即可生效

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 moli 无头浏览器（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron；单发动机 moli serve 直连，自动注入 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 与 FONTCONFIG_FILE，profile 目录持久化登录态）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

description.en: Registers a configurable prompt variable so an agent preset whose persona uses complete: true can still receive an injected text block; the plugin ships no content of its own and reads the text from its config.
description.zh: 注册一个可配置的 prompt 变量，让使用 complete: true 人格的 agent 预设也能收到一段注入文本；插件本身不含内容，文本由配置提供。

description.en: Removes sandbox_permissions / justification arguments that cannot widen the call's current sandbox mode, so calls no longer fail with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode'. GPT models tend to fill these optional fields on every call and pick workspace-write, which is narrower than danger-full-access. Runs in tools/pre-execute: compares the requested mode with the mode the session's sandbox policy resolves, and drops the fields when the request is the same or narrower (also drops a lone justification). Also understands the values GPT carries over from Codex's own shell tool: null, empty and use_default are treated as no request, and in a danger-full-access session any value (including require_escalated) is dropped because nothing is wider. Real widening requests, unknown modes and tools that do not advertise DSH's escalation schema are left to DSH core. Never widens permissions. Configurable tool list (default bash, pwsh, write, edit, run_code). Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 去掉那些不会让当前沙箱模式变宽的 sandbox_permissions / justification 参数，避免调用报错「sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode」。GPT 系列模型往往每次调用都会填这两个可选参数，并选 workspace-write，而它比 danger-full-access 更窄。插件在 tools/pre-execute 阶段把请求的模式和会话沙箱策略给出的当前模式做比较：相同或更窄时去掉这两个字段（只有 justification 时也会去掉）。同时兼容 GPT 从 Codex shell 工具带过来的取值：null、空值和 use_default 视为没有请求；会话已经是 danger-full-access 时，任何取值（包括 require_escalated）都会去掉，因为不存在更宽的模式。真正的升权请求、无法识别的模式值，以及没有声明 DSH 升权参数的工具，都原样交给 DSH 处理。不会放宽任何权限。监控的工具列表可配置（默认 bash、pwsh、write、edit、run_code）。零依赖。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative cloning, and launching and managing Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Requires an AdWhispr account.
description.zh: 通过 mcp-remote 加浏览器 OAuth 登录，把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AdWhispr 的远程 MCP 服务：竞品广告调研、广告创意克隆，以及 Meta／Google／TikTok 广告的投放与管理。需要 AdWhispr 账号。

description.en: Tracks this turn cost under the input box, today tokens and spend in the sidebar with peak and idle pricing, and pins the latest question to the top of the conversation.
description.zh: 输入框下方显示本轮花费；侧栏显示今日 token、消费与高峰/空闲时段；对话区顶部钉住最新提问，点击可跳回。

description.en: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan provider route for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): all 15 Coding Plan models with per-model reasoning-effort control, generated from a single source and drift-checked weekly.
description.zh: 给 DSH 接入火山方舟 Coding Plan 全部 15 个模型，每个都能单独调思考强度，元数据每周自动校验。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: bridge the cua-driver MCP server in as native computer-use tools.
description.zh: 把 Cua Driver 的 MCP 服务接进 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 真正能操作你的电脑。

description.en: 策略声明 vs 实际执行：说好不干的事干了没，干了的有没有说
description.zh: 把项目策略声明和实际代码摆一起比，看说好不干的事干了没、干了的有没有说。

description.en: 把一个 AI 变成持续的智能体：人设 + 不断累积的记忆与日志；支持把既有对话写成 DSH 真会话，并可增量追加同步。不是克隆，是迁居。
description.zh: 给 AI 装上人设和长期记忆，把旧对话搬进 DSH 变成能持续成长的智能体。

description.en: Agnes image & video generation for DeepSeek Harness: two agent tools, an AI prompt optimizer and a sidebar panel — poster-first cards, honest progress. No API key shipped. / DSH 的 Agnes 图像与视频生成插件：两个 Agent 工具、AI 提示词优化器与侧边栏面板；封面优先卡片、诚实进度条；不含任何密钥。

给 DSH Agent 加一组 cq_* 工具，调用 cq CLI 跑确定性的代码质量检查流程。

description.en: AI 生成内容标识合规：生成的东西标了没、有没有人工核验提示

description.en: 用于dsh上使用的操控Alist的插件

description.en: Keeps archived sessions out of the DSH conversation list and adds a panel to restore them or delete them permanently - session log, archive and pin records, and projection cache.
description.zh: 把已归档的会话从对话列表里藏起来，还能集中恢复或彻底删除，DSH 本身做不到的永久删除它来补。

description.zh: 自动给对话起名字，首条提问就能命名，重命名时还会用 AI 流式推荐标题。

description.en: DSH 八字模式插件：四柱排盘与命理分析（Host 工具 + Web 页签）

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-summarizes a Bilibili video when you send nothing but its link

description.en: Model-controlled context blocks for DeepSeek Harness PTC mode
description.zh: 让模型自己管理上下文分块，PTC 模式下自动整理和切换对话内容，省心又高效。

description.en: 550W-style boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: play a video full-screen when DSH opens, and reveal the UI only after it finishes.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 / skill：在 Boss 直聘求职者侧逐条浏览岗位，为每条 JD 生成只属于它的自我介绍并发给 HR —— 可见浏览器 + CDP 状态机 + 文案护栏，引擎零第三方依赖
description.zh: 在 Boss 直聘求职者侧自动翻岗位，为每条 JD 生成专属自我介绍并直接发给 HR。
从真实 git 历史生成用户版和开发者版两份中文变更日志，每条都带 commit SHA 和验证标记。

description.en: 设置DSH Harness对话流字体、字号行间距，以及对话文字到窗口边缘的留白。
description.zh: 给对话流加一页排版设置，统一调字体、字号、行距和边距，让聊天界面更顺眼。

description.en: ChatGPT-style conversation layout for the DeepSeek Harness Web client.
description.zh: 把 DSH 网页版对话流改成 ChatGPT 那样，还能给正文语义上色、加图标，并切换思考/快速模式。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin bridging to Cherry Studio desktops over the LAN (remote access): QR pairing, 14 cherry_* tools, and a settings page for devices and tool scope.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 通过局域网桥接到 Cherry Studio 桌面端，扫码配对即可远程调用 14 个工具。

description.zh: 在右侧栏搜文件名和内容，还能查代码符号、跳转调用关系，点一下直接跳到对应行。

description.en: DSH Web 客户端的 Codex 风格「思考强度」电源滑块 —— 拖一下就切换会话的真实推理强度；紫色扫描、漂浮星尘、拖柄墨点全部手写，零构建零依赖。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页端加一颗 Codex 风格的思考强度滑块，拖一下就能切换会话的真实推理档位。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Codex reset events, schedules, and source posts, with a composer status popover and the codex_reset agent tool.
description.zh: 在输入框实时查看 Codex 重置状态和排期，还能让 AI 助手直接查询重置信息。

description.en: DSH Desktop 冷启动开机动画插件 · Arknights 风格 HUD boot sequence for DeepSeek Harness (dsh-cold-boot)
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端加一段 44 秒方舟风格冷启动开机动画，纯 CSS 零依赖，装完即播可跳过。

description.en: PowerMode-style tool-call combo feedback for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop, with a countdown, four effects and live customization.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页版和桌面版里显示每轮思考与工具调用的连击反馈，带倒计时和四种特效，还能实时自定义。

description.en: DSH 插件：在插件设置卡里调会话自动压缩的触发阈值与保留比例，保存即时写进 agent preset 隔离的压缩引擎
description.zh: 在插件设置卡里调会话自动压缩的触发阈值和保留比例，保存即时生效，不用重启。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件与设置备份 / 跨机同步工具：一键把全部插件、配置和插件数据打包成可移植 .zip，在新电脑上先预览再批量还原。5 个 agent 工具 + 零依赖独立 CLI；凭据默认排除、可选 AES-256-GCM 加密导出；还原默认只预览，应用前自动生成还原点。
description.zh: 一键把 DSH 插件和配置打包成 zip，换电脑时预览后批量还原，还能加密导出。

description.en: 使用atomcode工具审核代码，查看本机应用返回的5小时用量。
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 AtomCode 接进 DSH 当侧边工具台，随时审核代码、查看 5 小时用量。

description.en: Cut model-facing tokens out of tool output before it enters a request. A global DeepSeek Harness plugin: lossless normalization, annotated repetition collapse, and recoverable structure-aware trimming.
description.zh: 在工具输出进入模型请求前自动瘦身，去掉冗余 token，省成本又不丢关键信息。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：/context 斜杠命令 + 上下文用量面板（占用构成、计费用量、轮数/步数/输出速度、账户余额）。零依赖、无构建。 | Zero-dependency DeepSeek Harness plugin: /context command and an at-a-glance context usage panel.
description.zh: 一条命令看清上下文都花在哪了：分段占用、计费用量、轮数步数和账户余额一屏全有。

description.en: A continue button beside the composer send key in the DSH Web GUI: one click sends an interruption-aware continuation prompt so an interrupted task picks up where it stopped.
description.zh: 在发送键旁加个「继续」按钮，一键让被中断的任务接着往下做。

description.en: Agent-authored monitoring and control panels for real machines and apps in DeepSeek Harness. A2UI-inspired, persistent, extensible.
description.zh: 把机器和应用的监控管理交给 AI 助手，自动生成常驻可扩展的控制面板。

description.en: Session cost and remaining provider balance below the DeepSeek Harness Web composer.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框下方实时显示当前会话及所有子会话的模型花费和供应商剩余余额，帮你随时掌握成本。

description.en: 抓虾浏览器插件｜DeepSeek Harness（DSH）API 优先网页自动化、实时预览、人工接管、上传下载、业务核验与可复用工作流，独立运行无需抓虾后端。
description.zh: 让 AI 直接操作浏览器：自动跑网页流程、实时预览、随时人工接管，还能上传下载和核验业务数据。

description.en: 抓虾数据插件｜DeepSeek Harness（DSH）CSV / Excel / JSON 预览、数据概览、筛选去重、排序转换与表格导出。独立运行，无需抓虾后端。
description.zh: 不用后端也能预览 CSV、Excel、JSON，随手筛选去重、排序转换再导出表格。

description.en: 抓虾 Office 插件｜DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Word / PowerPoint 生成、文本提取与 OOXML 检查校验。独立运行，无需 Python 或抓虾后端。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接生成和解析 Word、PPT 文档，还能校验 OOXML，不用装 Python。

description.en: 跨会话派活插件 for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x：十工具（spawn/send/reply/list/read/status/broadcast/rename/archive/approve）+ 跨会话审批桥 + cs_ 短别名 + agent_preset 自定义模式（v0.3.8）
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的多个会话互相派活、回传结果，还能跨会话审批，任务编排更省心。

description.en: Replace DSH's built-in DeepSeek search with SearXNG / Tavily / Exa / Brave / Serper / Bing / Google CSE. web_search keeps its name and schema.
description.zh: 把 DSH 自带的 DeepSeek 搜索换成 SearXNG、Tavily、Exa 等七种搜索引擎，接口不变即插即用。

description.en: Use your own OpenAI-compatible vision model in DeepSeek Harness: images are described before the main model sees the request, plus an image_understand tool for charts, screenshots, UI and OCR.
description.zh: 接入你自己的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，发图先转成文字再给主模型，还能识别图表、截图和 OCR。

description.en: 数据留存期限检查：数据不该永远躺着，该删的删了没
description.zh: 静态检查项目的数据留存漏洞，看看日志、数据库、上传目录该删的删了没。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 里所有未声明 reasoningEfforts 的模型自动补上 high / xhigh / max 三档的 Host 插件：零运行时依赖、无构建步骤、幂等，写入走 configEditor 正常路径并刻意放在 HMR 事务之外。
description.zh: 给没声明推理等级的模型自动补上 high / xhigh / max 三档，装上就能用。

description.en: DSH 0.2 session deletion plugin: adds Delete session to the sidebar Session row menu via the official slot API, backed by a Host route that removes the session artifact and maintains the workspace ledger.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话行一键永久删除会话，清掉本地全部记录并同步工作区，补上官方缺失的功能。

description.en: A 7x24 resident personal assistant for DeepSeek Harness: human-bound standing autonomy, self-wake across restarts, expiry-aware notices that stay silent unless they matter, and a read-only reach over every session, this machine and the person's work channels - it reads everything, drafts everything, and writes nothing.
description.zh: 一个常驻在线的私人助理，关机重启也能自己醒来，你不在时照样干活、记事儿，有事才提醒你。

description.en: 给 DSH 用的开发日志插件。自动记录"为什么"和"踩了什么坑"。
description.zh: 每轮工作结束自动把上下文写成开发日志，记下干了什么、为什么这么干、踩了什么坑。

description.en: 在deepseekharness中接入豆包语言模型，阅读对话。
description.zh: 给 DSH 里每条助手回答加个朗读按钮，点一下就用豆包语音把内容读出来。

description.en: Three-player LAN Doudizhu as a DSH floating-window plugin: 54 cards, bidding for landlord, clockwise play and landlord rotation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 浮窗里和局域网好友三人开一局斗地主，叫地主、轮流出牌、自动轮换地主。

description.en: Take a local video all the way to a Douyin creator post: open the upload page, trigger the picker, hand the file over with verification, fill the title, set visibility - then stop before publishing unless explicitly told to publish.
description.zh: 把本地视频一路送到抖音投稿页待发布状态：开页面、点上传、交文件校验、填标题设可见性，默认停手不发布。

description.en: 专为 DSH 的下载任务做的进度指示器：会话头里常驻的下载图标，自动发现正在跑的下载与后台任务，环形进度 + 动画进度条 + 速率 + 剩余时间；已完成文件单击即开，零第三方依赖。 · A download-progress indicator built for DSH's download tasks: a persistent session-header icon with a progress ring, animated bars, speed and ETA. Click a finished file to open it. No third-party plugin required.
description.zh: 在会话头常驻一个下载图标，自动追踪下载和后台任务，实时显示进度、速率和剩余时间，点一下就能打开文件。

description.en: A versioned DPIA workbench for DeepSeek Harness: trace facts, resolve gaps, reassess risks, and produce reviewable reports.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 做 DPIA 隐私影响评估：追踪事实、补齐缺口、重评风险并出可审报告。

description.en: Standalone DeepSeek Harness plugin: preview .drawio (mxGraph XML) diagrams in the Web Sidebar.侧边栏预览流程图  .drawio文件
description.zh: 在侧边栏直接预览 .drawio 流程图，不用离开 DSH 就能看图。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: edit .drawio diagrams in the Web Sidebar ,侧边栏编辑流程图  .drawio文件
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接打开和编辑 .drawio 流程图文件，改完即存，不用来回切换软件。

description.en: 配置文件审计：.env 有没有被提交、权限对不对、里面是不是明文
description.zh: 提交代码前先查一遍 .env：会不会被 git 跟踪、权限是否过宽、密钥有没有明文。

description.en: Per-session extra working directories for DSH: a session-settings option plus a runtime-context reminder that tells the model which extra directories this session may use.
description.zh: 给单个会话挂上额外的本地工作目录，模型能自动知道这次能用哪些目录。

description.en: Right-to-left display for Persian chat messages in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — a DSH plugin/bundle (per-block bidi auto-detection, no app file changes)
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 网页版里的波斯语聊天消息自动从右往左显示，不用改任何应用文件。

description.en: Hand a local file to any program's file picker: wait for the native Open dialog, paste the path through the clipboard, read it back to verify character by character, then confirm. The target is always explicit and every step leaves evidence.
description.zh: 让 AI 自动把本地文件塞进系统「打开文件」对话框，网页上传、微信发文件、PS 打开都不用你动手。

description.en: DSH right-sidebar file helper: annotate a selection in the document preview (text lines / Excel ranges / Word-PDF pages) or right-click a file, then send the quote plus your note into the current chat. Also ships the standalone zh/en/ja README summary.
description.zh: 在右侧栏划选文字、框选 Excel 区域或右键文件，带上批注一键送进当前对话，引用自动收成小胶囊。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补齐文件工具缺失的删除/建目录/移动能力。走进程内 fs 通路，严格遵守会话沙箱档位（完全权限可任意位置 / 工作区内可写不可越狱）。
description.zh: 给 DSH 补上删除、建目录、移动文件的能力，并严格按会话沙箱权限执行。
